rabbi-yehoshua-ben-kefusai.name: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Kefusai
rabbi-yehoshua-ben-kefusai.bio: Tanna cited in a baraita requiring two witnesses from outside a priest’s household to testify about a blemish on his firstborn.
rabbi-yehoshua-ben-kefusai.prompt: A sober, careful scholar in his 60s with a long grey beard and a measured, questioning gaze, in an undyed wool robe and a brown mantle. A stone-paved marketplace of a Galilean town, softly blurred, behind him.
